additional_findings.finding: Strided Safetensors leaves serialized storage order with the original logical shape; native scalar metadata returned zero-dimensional arrays.
additional_findings.outcome: C-contiguous leaf serialization and native scalar restoration preserve transpose values and HE indices metadata.

additional_findings.finding: Quantization changed integer/bool buffers; QSGD mishandled empty tensors, reset caller RNG and accepted invalid levels/trailing bytes.
additional_findings.outcome: Exact buffer dtype/value preservation, finite/shape/header validation, seeded stochastic rounding and explicit levels 2..128; independent error bound max(abs(x))/(levels-1)+1e-6.

additional_findings.finding: Feature compression failed empty batches/noncontiguous arrays and lost empty target dtype; shared headers could corrupt heterogeneous batches.
additional_findings.outcome: Empty/strided/homogeneous arrays roundtrip exactly; incompatible feature shapes/dtypes fail explicitly before compression while retaining the existing shared-header wire.

additional_findings.finding: CPU torch.device detection converted float32 feature tensors to float16 unnecessarily; randomized response mutated source tensors through a NumPy view.
additional_findings.outcome: Zero-noise CPU precision and targets preserved; randomized response works on a copy.

additional_findings.finding: Unstructured pruning reused inferred modules after trainer.model was replaced.
additional_findings.outcome: Infer current model targets for each call; independent magnitude reference zeros 1..4 and retains 5..8 after replacement.

additional_findings.finding: cleanup runtime fallback could follow a directory symlink and delete external checkpoints.
additional_findings.outcome: External resolved runtime and directory symlinks excluded; clean_directory refuses symlink targets; ordinary owned runtime/cache cleanup still executes.

additional_findings.finding: Importing count_parameters executed model downloads; empty compound loaders failed; unary epsilon=2000 overflowed.
additional_findings.outcome: Demos guarded by main, loaders terminate with len=0, stable negative-exponent probabilities with finite nonnegative epsilon checks.

additional_findings.finding: TOML Unicode keys and nested array-table paths produced invalid or misplaced output.
additional_findings.outcome: Independent stdlib tomllib roundtrip validates Unicode/literal dotted keys and nested array tables; historical mixed-type-array wrapper convention retained.

additional_findings.finding: HE accepted invalid sample accounting/masks/vector lengths, reordered caller masks and replaced model state before successful reconstruction.
additional_findings.outcome: Cardinality/finite nonnegative counts, positive total, mask and vector contracts checked; zero-sample rounds return baseline, failed decode leaves encrypted_model intact; native CKKS matches independent plaintext at abs 2e-5.

additional_findings.finding: Shamir reconstructed the wrong peer polynomial and single-client output retained sample scaling; floating polynomial arithmetic lost accuracy.
additional_findings.outcome: Correct sender/target share orientation, uniform normalization, integer coefficients/float64 exact-range checks and Fraction interpolation; thresholds 1/2/4 match independent weighted sums at abs 2e-6.

additional_findings.finding: Incomplete additive participants and inconsistent reports/shares could bias aggregates; stale writers could contaminate a later round; zero sample counts were dropped.
additional_findings.outcome: Participant/contributor accounting, sample/key/shape/finiteness checks and round fences under the store lock; asynchronous training captures expected round and persists zero counts; failures leave baseline/next round untouched.

additional_findings.finding: Interrupted local state saves destroyed the previous round; remote errors were misreported as missing rounds; failed/unbounded ZooKeeper lock acquisition leaked clients or allowed unlocked writes.
additional_findings.outcome: Atomic temporary-file replacement, missing-object-only fallback, finite start/lock waits and unconditional client stop; acquire false or errors prevent writes.

additional_findings.outcome: Every target row used; per-transition normalization, length masking and masked critic averages preserve batch isolation and source sequences.
